questions.stemHtml: A 62-year-old woman presents with a protruding mass from her vagina and difficulty urinating. Physical examination reveals third-degree uterine prolapse with an ulcerated area on the prolapsed tissue as shown in the image. Which of the following correctly describes the cause of the ulcerated area and the appropriate management for this condition? {{caption_text}}

options.label: A
options.text: Ulcer occurs due to infection; management includes antibiotics and surgical intervention.

options.label: B
options.text: Ulcer occurs due to repeated friction; management includes local wound care and topical corticosteroids.

options.label: C
options.text: Ulcer occurs due to allergic reactions; management includes antihistaminics and surgical intervention.

options.label: D
options.text: Ulcer occurs due to venous congestion; management includes antiseptic and hygroscopic packing.
